title: Indian-Style Stir Fry
description: A flavorful and aromatic Indian-inspired stir fry made with earthy vegetables and crunchy textures. Perfect for a quick lunch or dinner.
instructions: Heat oil in a large skillet or wok over medium-high heat.
Add the onion and cook until softened, about 3-4 minutes.
Add the garlic and cook for another minute.
Add the sweet potatoes and carrots, and cook for 5 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Add the mushrooms and soy sauce, and stir-fry for 2-3 minutes.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped cilantro or scallions.
